name: m2747-tree2
prompt: Cinematic vertical 9:16 photoreal, Arabian desert in the 7th century, bright warm daylight, vibrant natural colours, high detail. The sun disc is NOT visible. No people, no faces, no text, no buildings. A single large lone desert acacia tree (Acacia tortilis, samur) on a flat sandy plain, about five metres tall: a twisted grey trunk and a very wide flat umbrella-shaped crown of tiny green leaves and thorny branches, the crown wider than the tree is tall. The light comes from high above, so the tree casts a wide dappled shadow on the sand directly beneath the crown. INSIDE that shadow, close to the trunk, lie a folded brown wool cloak, a plain straight wooden walking staff and an empty wooden bowl - small next to the big tree, all three fully in the shade, none of them in the sunlight. No person, no animal. Camera at a distance so the whole tree and its shadow are in frame, vast empty desert around, wide sky.
